changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/8499-node-slot-registered-arms.md`

- names `renderers/form/calendar.tsx` → `packages/components/src/renderers/form/calendar.tsx` — edited by this change

  > - `SemanticElementSchema` (`zod/layout.zod.ts`) — the seven HTML sectioning tags `renderers/layout/semantic.tsx` registers: `aside` `main` `header` `nav` `footer` `section` `article`. - `HtmlElementSchema` (`zod/layout.zod.ts`) — the 37 safe flow/inline tags `renderers/basic/html-elements.tsx` registers (`h1`…`h6`, `p`, `a`, `ul`, `img`, …), plus the per-tag keys that module forwards to the DOM (`href`, `target`, `rel`, `title`, `src`, `alt`, `width`, `height`, `dateTime`, `cite`). ⚠️ **Dated note, 2026-09-27 — that set has since gained `code` — objectui#10756.** At this change `TAGS` and this arm both named 37 tags; both now name 38, and the parity pin counts 38. The rest of this entry is kept as the reading of this change. - `InputShorthandSchema` (`zod/form.zod.ts`) — `email` / `password`, the two aliases `renderers/form/input.tsx` registers onto the `input` renderer with `inputType` pinned. `inputType` is deliberately NOT declared on this arm: the wrapper spreads its own value last, so an authored one is overwritten. - `UiCalendarSchema` (`zod/form.zod.ts`) — `ui:calendar`, the date-picker primitive `renderers/form/calendar.tsx` registers under exactly that key (`skipFallback`, because bare `calendar` belongs to the plugin-calendar view).

### `.changeset/9067-zod-barrel-named-arms.md`

- names `renderers/form/calendar.tsx` → `packages/components/src/renderers/form/calendar.tsx` — edited by this change

  > - `InputShorthandSchema` (`zod/form.zod.ts`) — the `email` / `password` shorthand arm. - `UiCalendarSchema` (`zod/form.zod.ts`) — `ui:calendar`, the date-picker primitive `renderers/form/calendar.tsx` registers, a different component from the `calendar` plugin view that owns the bare literal.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `256b4c9ef` (merge-base with origin/main): 10 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1626 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2215 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36346263340)

## Contract review

Served-tier: 171/171 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e22bfd67d1b5bb1750f325263871abfb8bb8dc3d`

Read: the card thread on objectui#10799 (triage 5858019009, claim 5858309247; the os-dev-report 5859155332 opened only to list claims to test); objectui#10747 and merged PR objectui#10798 with its file list (it patched `ui/calendar.tsx` as declared patches under `scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`); PR 10838 body, its 11-file list and unified diff; the merge-base `33e58d8` with `origin/main` (`8eaa1a0`; the PR is two commits, `c5d6e48` and `e22bfd6`); head sources of the five callers, `ui/calendar.tsx`, `ui/popover.tsx`, `plugin-calendar/src/calendar-view-renderer.tsx`, `ObjectCalendar.tsx`, `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` (the hoist docstring), `packages/core/src/utils/date-display.ts` (`toDisplayDate`), `scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts`, `scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs` (three declared calendar patches), `vitest.config.mts` (projects, `process.env.TZ = 'UTC'`, the alias map to every package's `src`), the three `tsconfig.test.json`, the two plugin `package.json`, `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/components-form-date-picker/with-default-value.json`; installed react-day-picker 10.0.1 (`dist/esm/helpers/getInitialMonth.js`, `useCalendar.js`, `helpers/useControlledValue.js`) and date-fns 4.4.0, probed in node under `TZ=America/Los_Angeles`; AGENTS.md at the head (#7 No-Touch zones, §9 Housekeeping changeset rule, 怎么跑测试, 测试纪律, 版本号策略); `.changeset/config.json` and every pending `.changeset/*.md` that names a touched file or component (8499, 9067, 10293, 10304, 10377, 10722, 10132, 5458, 6442, 8072, 9406, nine-holdouts); the head's check-runs at 19:38:23Z and 19:50:30Z. Ran once, in a detached throwaway worktree at `e22bfd6` under `os-verify-lock` slot `review-10838` (offline install, no build; every workspace package is aliased to `src`): the three pin files plus one probe file of my own, `4 files / 20 passed / 0 skipped`; ran that probe once more with the worktree at the merge-base `33e58d8` to separate new from inherited. Worktree removed without `--force`; `/home/user/objectui` untouched.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Census — RIGHT.** `git grep -nP` for a JSX `Calendar` element over `packages/**` and `apps/**` at the head (tests, `__tests__`, CHANGELOGs and `dist` excluded) gives 10 hits in 9 files. Five mount the primitive, and each passes `defaultMonth` at the head: `packages/components/src/custom/date-picker.tsx` (imports `../ui/calendar`), `packages/components/src/renderers/form/calendar.tsx` (`../../ui`), `packages/components/src/renderers/form/date-picker.tsx` (`../../ui`), `packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.tsx` and `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardFilterBar.tsx` (both `@object-ui/components`, whose `ui` barrel re-exports `./calendar`). The other four files import `Calendar` from `lucide-react`: `FieldStub.tsx`, `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `ViewSwitcher.tsx`, `SharedViewLink.tsx` (two hits); `CreateViewDialog.tsx` aliases lucide's `Calendar as CalendarIcon`. No mount in `apps/**`, no `createElement(Calendar`, no `component={Calendar}`, and the only direct `DayPicker` element is inside `ui/calendar.tsx`. No mount passes `month`. No mount missed.

2. **Per site — RIGHT.** `CalendarView`: `defaultMonth={selectedDate}` and `selected={selectedDate}`, one state value. `ui:calendar`: `selected` is computed once (`toSelection(mode, schema.value || schema.defaultValue)`) and `firstSelectedDay(selected)` reads that same object: the `Date` in single, `.find(isDay)` (first valid in list order) in multiple, `.from` in range; an undefined selection yields undefined. Form date-picker: `defaultMonth={value}` and `selected={value}`; an authored ISO string reaches `value` unparsed, and date-fns 4 `toDate` parses it identically on both sides (`startOfMonth` for the month, `isSameDay` for the selection). Measured through the real `SchemaRenderer` over `{ type: 'date-picker', id: 'due', value: '2024-01-15' }`: caption `January 2024`, selected `data-day` `2024-01-15`. `DatePicker`: `defaultMonth={date}` and `selected={date}`. Dashboard: `defaultMonth={openingMonth}`, the guarded `rangeFrom` that `selected.from` reads. Every site hands undefined with no value, and `getInitialMonth` (`month || defaultMonth || today`) falls to today: all five controls read `September 2026` under the faked clock.

3. **Invalid dates — WRONG at one site.** The two guards are complete: `ui:calendar` turns `'not-a-date'` into an Invalid Date (`toDisplayDate` returns its `new Date(value)` when the string matches neither ISO regex) and `isDay` filters it (measured: today, no throw); the dashboard's `openingMonth` drops a NaN `rangeFrom` (measured: `September 2026`, `October 2026`, no throw). The two pickers need no guard, as claimed: `DatePicker` with `date={new Date(NaN)}` throws `RangeError: Invalid time value` in the trigger's `format` at the merge-base and at the head alike, and a `date-picker` node with `value: 'not-a-date'` is caught by `SchemaErrorBoundary` at that same `format` call at both (`Component "date-picker" failed to render` / `Invalid time value` / `Retry`; no trigger with `id="due"`, no popover). **`CalendarView` is the site the PR left open.** Its `currentDate` prop is a `Date`. `calendar-view-renderer.tsx` resolves an authored string to a valid `Date` or undefined, but by its own docstring passes a host-handed `Date` instance through untouched, "invalid instances included", and records that such a value "does not throw; it renders the literal text 'Invalid Date' into the header and the date picker" (the header formats with `toLocaleDateString`, which does not throw). Measured with `‹CalendarView events={[]} currentDate={new Date(NaN)} view="month" /›` under an English session: at the merge-base the header reads `Invalid Date` and clicking it opens the popover on `September 2026`; at the head the header reads `Invalid Date` and clicking it throws `RangeError: Invalid time value` out of the render (caught by nothing in the probe, no window error event). The PR's own rule, "a day that names no instant passes no month", was applied at `ui:calendar` and the dashboard and not here, and the reason given for skipping the pickers (the trigger's `format` throws first) does not hold for this header. This is a path that can throw at render, introduced by the PR. One expression closes it, `defaultMonth={Number.isNaN(selectedDate.getTime()) ? undefined : selectedDate}`, and the changeset sentence "react-day-picker throws on an invalid `defaultMonth`, so it is never passed one" is untrue at the head for this door.

4. **Re-open — RIGHT, with one statement gap.** react-day-picker 10.0.1 seeds `firstMonth` from `getInitialMonth` through `useControlledValue` (a `useState` initial value) and re-reads it only in an effect keyed on `props.timeZone`, so a re-read needs a remount. `ui/popover.tsx` wraps `PopoverPrimitive.Content` in a `Portal` with no `forceMount`, so the content unmounts on close at all four popover sites: `CalendarView` (uncontrolled; pinned: open `March 2020`, Escape, Previous, open again `February 2020`), form date-picker and `DatePicker` (uncontrolled, same primitive, not pinned), dashboard (controlled `open={customOpen}`, unmounts when false). The inline `ui:calendar` reads `defaultMonth` once at mount; a `value` that changes afterwards does not move the month. Acceptable for a schema-driven inline calendar, and stated in the PR body (acceptance note 4), but not in the source comment or `calendar.mdx`, which say only that it "opens on" the first selected day.

5. **Date-only zone — RIGHT (inherits, adds nothing).** The dashboard stores `toIsoDate(range.from)` (local `yyyy-MM-dd`) and parses it back with `new Date(value.from)` (UTC midnight); the parse is unchanged by this PR. `defaultMonth` reads the very `rangeFrom` that `selected.from` reads, so west of UTC a range from `2026-03-01` opens on February with 28 February highlighted, where before it opened on today with the same wrong highlight out of view: the opening month follows the highlight, and a correctly parsed month beside a UTC-parsed selection would put the highlight out of the opened view instead; the two-month view still shows March. The form date-picker's ISO-string door behaves the same way: date-fns parses the string as UTC on both sides (probed in Los Angeles: `startOfMonth('2024-01-01')` is 1 December 2023 and `isSameDay('2024-01-01', 31 Dec 2023 local)` is true), and its trigger label already reads `January 14th, 2024` for `2024-01-15` there at the merge-base. Both are the `toDisplayDate` family, not this PR's defect.

6. **Primitive and shape — RIGHT.** `packages/components/src/ui/calendar.tsx` has blob `9429194795979aa236769227aabedbedcc7c6f7f` at the head, at the merge-base and at `origin/main`; it spreads `{...props}` last onto `DayPicker`, so `defaultMonth` reaches it. No barrel changed (`src/index.ts`, `custom/index.ts`, `ui/index.ts`, `renderers/**/index.ts` identical to the merge-base); `firstSelectedDay` is module-private. Changeset: three `patch` entries, no `major`. PR body: first line `Fixes #10799`, second `Clause-②: no`, which holds (no export, no declared input, the `ui:calendar` registration `inputs` unchanged). Sentences that hold: "Five `Calendar` mounts passed `selected` only", "With no value, each still opens on today", "The `Calendar` primitive itself is unchanged", the `CalendarView` measurement.
